systems.name: Monocytes, macrophages & dendritic cells
systems.description: Myeloid cell abundance, phenotype, antigen presentation and measured functions.

systems.name: Neutrophils & extracellular traps
systems.description: Neutrophil phenotypes, granulocyte activity and NET-related measurements.

systems.name: Mast cells, histamine & allergic effectors
systems.description: Mast cells, basophils, eosinophils, IgE and measured histamine/allergic mediators.

systems.name: Innate sensing, inflammasomes & host defense
systems.description: Pattern-recognition receptors, inflammasome activation and measured innate host-defense programs.

systems.name: Complement
systems.description: Classical, alternative and lectin-pathway components, activation products and functional assays.

systems.name: NK cells & innate cytotoxicity
systems.description: Natural-killer/innate lymphoid phenotypes, cytotoxic machinery and functional assays.

systems.name: T-cell activation, differentiation & exhaustion
systems.description: CD4/CD8 and other T-cell populations, activation/exhaustion markers and TCR-related measurements.

systems.name: Regulatory T cells & immune tolerance
systems.description: Treg abundance, subsets, phenotype and suppressive function. Distinct subsets remain identifiable within the shared display node.

systems.name: B cells, plasma cells & immunoglobulins
systems.description: B-cell/plasma-cell populations, antibody production, immunoglobulin classes and BCR repertoires.

systems.name: Autoantibodies & autoreactivity
systems.description: Measured self-reactive antibodies, receptor autoantibodies and autoreactivity assays; positivity does not establish pathogenicity.

systems.name: Pathogen-specific immune responses
systems.description: Antigen-specific antibodies, neutralization, and pathogen-specific lymphocyte responses. These are distinct from detecting the pathogen itself.

systems.name: Type I/III interferons & antiviral programs
systems.description: IFN-alpha/beta/lambda, their receptors and explicitly identified interferon-stimulated antiviral programs.

systems.name: IFN-gamma, IL-12 & type 1 immunity
systems.description: IFN-gamma/IL-12-related measurements and explicitly identified Th1 programs; membership does not imply a cell of origin.

systems.name: IL-4/IL-5/IL-13 & type 2 immunity
systems.description: Type 2 cytokine and explicitly identified Th2 measurements.

systems.name: IL-17/IL-23 & Th17-associated biology
systems.description: IL-17/IL-23-family measurements and explicitly identified Th17 programs.

systems.name: IL-1, IL-6 & TNF inflammatory signaling
systems.description: These cytokine families and their receptors/regulators. Antagonists and receptor levels retain their distinct identities.

systems.name: IL-10, TGF-beta & regulatory cytokines
systems.description: Regulatory/growth-factor cytokine measurements. Context-dependent effects are not reduced to a universal anti-inflammatory sign.

systems.name: Chemokines & leukocyte trafficking
systems.description: CC/CXC/CX3C/XC chemokines, chemokine receptors and measured cell-trafficking signals.

systems.name: Acute-phase & systemic inflammatory markers
systems.description: CRP, acute-phase proteins, sedimentation and broad blood inflammatory indices; these are nonspecific markers.

systems.name: Endothelium, vascular barriers & angiogenesis
systems.description: Endothelial activation, adhesion, glycocalyx, vascular junctions and angiogenic mediators.

systems.name: Platelets, coagulation & fibrinolysis
systems.description: Platelet biology, coagulation factors, fibrin/microclots and fibrinolytic measurements.

systems.name: Erythrocytes, iron & oxygen carriage
systems.description: Red-cell indices, hemoglobin, iron handling and related oxygen-carriage measurements.

systems.name: Perfusion, microcirculation & oxygen delivery
systems.description: Blood-flow, microvascular reactivity and tissue oxygenation measurements, kept distinct from arterial oxygen saturation and intrinsic mitochondrial respiration.

systems.name: Autonomic function & orthostatic physiology
systems.description: HRV, autonomic testing, orthostatic hemodynamics, sweating and related physiological readouts.

systems.name: Cardiac function, injury & hemodynamics
systems.description: Cardiac imaging, electrophysiology, injury markers and central hemodynamic measurements.

systems.name: Pulmonary function, gas exchange & lung imaging
systems.description: Spirometry, diffusion, ventilation, blood gases and measured lung structure/pathology.

systems.name: Brain structure, activity & connectivity
systems.description: Structural/functional brain imaging and central electrophysiology. Cognitive questionnaire/test scores are not standalone nodes.

systems.name: Neuroimmune activity, glia & neural injury
systems.description: Glial/neuronal injury markers, brain immune activity and barrier-related neural measurements.

systems.name: Peripheral nerves, sensory & motor physiology
systems.description: Peripheral nerve, small-fiber, neuromuscular and directly tested sensory measurements, including olfactory testing.

systems.name: Sleep & circadian physiology
systems.description: Instrumented sleep, circadian timing and measured activity/sleep rhythms; self-report sleep scales are excluded.

systems.name: Skeletal muscle & exercise physiology
systems.description: Muscle structure, force, body-composition assays and objective exercise capacity/CPET measurements. Performance endpoints remain distinguishable from molecular biomarkers.

systems.name: Mitochondria & cellular bioenergetics
systems.description: Respiration, oxidative phosphorylation, ATP synthesis, mitochondrial dynamics and intrinsic mitochondrial measurements.

systems.name: Oxidative stress & antioxidant defenses
systems.description: Measured reactive species, oxidation products, antioxidants and redox defense systems.

systems.name: Glucose, insulin & central carbon metabolism
systems.description: Glycemia/insulin regulation, glycolysis and central carbon substrates/enzymes, with context preserved.

systems.name: Lipids, fatty acids & lipoproteins
systems.description: Lipid classes, lipoprotein particles, lipid metabolism and fatty-acid measurements.

systems.name: Amino acids & nitrogen metabolism
systems.description: Amino-acid abundance, metabolism and nitrogen-related biochemical pathways.

systems.name: Tryptophan, kynurenine & serotonin
systems.description: Tryptophan catabolites, serotonin and explicitly measured pathway components; tissue and source remain separate.

systems.name: Purines, pyrimidines & nucleotide metabolism
systems.description: Nucleotide/nucleoside metabolites and their turnover/signaling measurements.

systems.name: Microbiome composition & microbial metabolism
systems.description: Measured microbial taxa, diversity, metagenomic functions and explicitly microbial metabolites. Not equivalent to viable infection.

systems.name: Intestinal barrier & microbial translocation
systems.description: Gut permeability, epithelial integrity and measured translocation products/responses.

systems.name: Viral persistence, reactivation & pathogen detection
systems.description: Pathogen nucleic acids/antigens, tissue detection and directly measured microbial infection. Serology alone remains in pathogen-specific immunity.

systems.name: HPA axis & adrenal stress hormones
systems.description: Cortisol, ACTH and measured adrenal/HPA-axis activity, with sampling time and assay context retained.

systems.name: Thyroid, reproductive & other endocrine signaling
systems.description: Thyroid, gonadal and other endocrine hormones/receptors and measured endocrine axes; sex itself is not a node.

systems.name: Renal function, fluids & electrolytes
systems.description: Renal injury/function, fluid regulation, ions and acid-base measurements.

systems.name: Hepatic, digestive & nutritional biochemistry
systems.description: Liver/pancreatic biochemistry, bile-related and nutrient-status measurements; BMI/anthropometric risk labels are excluded.

systems.name: Extracellular matrix, fibrosis & mineralization
systems.description: Matrix turnover, collagen/fibrosis, remodeling and mineralization regulators.

systems.name: Cell stress, death, senescence & proteostasis
systems.description: Apoptosis/other cell-death pathways, senescence, autophagy and protein stress responses.

systems.name: Extracellular vesicles & intercellular cargo
systems.description: Vesicle abundance, origin, physical characteristics and measured cargo; cargo identity remains visible.

systems.name: Genetic susceptibility & epigenetic regulation
systems.description: Variants, HLA alleles, methylation/chromatin and other measured genetic/epigenetic associations; these are not proof of causal genes.

systems.name: RNA, protein expression & molecular regulation
systems.description: Explicit RNA/protein expression programs, translation and signaling assays lacking a more specific biological assignment. Unidentified individual molecules are not forced into this group.
